summary: AstraZeneca PLC filed a Form 6-K to notify admission of 1,072 ordinary shares to trading on the London Stock Exchange Main Market. These shares were issued between 1 August 2026 and 31 August 2026 under the company's existing block admission dated 29 January 2021 for employee share schemes. Total shares in issue post-admission stand at 1,551,043,461. No prospectus or supplementary document was required. This is a routine administrative disclosure regarding employee share plan issuances, not a special situation.
